delivery.intro: How the web server serves course files. In both modes access is decided by the signature: the application verifies it, and only the user it was issued for receives the file.
delivery.switchHint: Off — Laravel reads and serves the file. On — Laravel only verifies the signature and returns a header; nginx serves the file.
delivery.nginxWarning: nginx mode works only if the web server config has an internal location with the internal directive. Until it exists, materials will not open: responses will be empty.
delivery.workerHint: Why switch: in php mode every byte of material passes through PHP and occupies a worker for the whole transfer. In nginx mode the web server opens the file itself, and PHP is not involved.
delivery.loadFailed: Failed to load the delivery mode
delivery.saveFailed: Failed to save the delivery mode
delivery.preflightConfig: What the nginx config must contain:

tutor.title: Self-study
tutor.intro: Questions on your course materials prepared by a local model. The score does not affect your learning result: the exam is taken separately.
tutor.disabled: The tutor is switched off. An administrator can enable it in settings.
tutor.engineDown: The AI engine is unavailable. Training is not possible until it is running.

tutor.noMaterialsText: An instructor prepares the materials. Ask them if the course is not ready yet.
tutor.syncQueueHint: The queue is synchronous: questions are prepared during the request. This takes up to a minute and depends on the model and CPU load.
tutor.workerStalled: The tutor is waiting for a queue worker: the job is queued but `php artisan queue:work` is not running. Start it in a separate terminal — questions will appear on their own.
tutor.exhaustedText: You have gone through all prepared questions. New ones appear after the next batch.
